-----------------------------------------------------------------------
[center]
来自苏镇的年轻男孩小铭。温柔、多愁善感，来自苏镇。
[b]
小铭mod添加了新NPC：小铭和他的猫。[/b] 从农场北出口进入边远森林，即可看到山坡旁边的栅栏，沿着栅栏进入山洞就可来到小铭的院子。[/center]

[center][color=#ffd966][size=4][b]温馨提示[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[list=1]
[*]小铭温柔又多愁善感，他有一个前女友，并且会在低好感时偶尔想念她。此外他有时会有些[b][color=#fff2cc]抑郁倾向[/color][/b]。如果你在意这个， [b][color=#fff2cc]请谨慎游玩。[/color][/b]
[*]目前我没有做约会和婚后内容，小铭会拒绝你的花束，并且在8心事件后[b][color=#fff2cc]会变为不可婚。[/color][/b]原因是这本来是一个私人向的mod，目前的内容对我来说已经圆满了，并且很明显如果我要做约会或婚后内容的话会做大量的对话和事件，会是一个极大的工作量。目前我没有这么多的精力和动力。但如果[b][color=#fff2cc]真的很多人想要约会和婚后内容的话，我应该会更新。[/color][/b]
[*]根据第2条，请注意，[color=#fff2cc][b]如果使用多婚之类的mod强制和小铭或大橘结婚，导致的bug我无法修复。[/b][/color]为获得预期体验，请不要这样做。实在想要婚后内容的请留言并尊重支持我的创作，感谢理解。
[/list]
[b][color=#3d85c6][size=4][center]内容[/center][/size][/color][/b]
[color=#9fc5e8][size=4][b]新人物:[/b][/size][/color]
丰富的肖像、行程、动画[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]大量对话:[/color] 根据季节、好感、特殊日期改变的大量对话，以及第二年高好感会有新对话
[*][color=#9fc5e8]大量事件:[/color] 目前小铭共12个事件，包括0-8心的全部好感事件、10心特殊事件、生日事件和跨年事件
[/list] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿注意：[color=#ffe599]部分事件结束之后小铭会有特殊对话，有时会包含特殊物品[/color]。也许可以试着在事件之后和他对话？[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]大量信件:[/color] 目前有超过50封信件和4种不同信纸，信件内容包括季节、节日、事件、日常送礼等。
[/list]
[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=4]新地图:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]小铭的院子:[/color] 每日随机生成可觅食的水果、作物、鱼，晕倒不会扣钱
[*][color=#9fc5e8] ﻿小铭的家:[/color] 有厨房和睡觉点，晕倒不会扣钱
[*][color=#9fc5e8]苏镇: [/color]小铭的家乡，可用于观光、钓鱼，未来更新会加入更多功能
[*] ﻿[color=#9fc5e8]夜雨客栈: [/color]苏镇的睡觉点和商店，晕倒不会扣钱
[*] ﻿[color=#9fc5e8]夜雨客房: [/color]可睡觉、泡温泉（回复体力和生命）、使用厨房、查看日历、查看当日幸运和明日天气
[/list]
[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=4]新物品:[/size][/color][/b]
﻿在对话、信件、客栈商店中加入超过40种新物品，包括食物、鞋子、帽子、戒指、栅栏、道具、装饰品等，以及5种新buff[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]新配方:[/color]添加了3种烹饪配方和2种制造配方 
[/list][list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]新作物:[/color]﻿苏镇茉莉，对应加入多种工匠制品配方，以及全新工匠制品贴图
[/list][list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]新鱼:[/color]﻿苏镇加入了8种独特的苏镇锦鲤，包括2种极其稀有的boss鱼，根据天气和季节不同分布，放在鱼缸观赏会有独立动画，且每种鱼都有独特的鱼塘颜色。
[/list] ﻿ ﻿注意：默认配置是不添加苏镇锦鲤到收集图鉴，这样你就无需钓齐全部的锦鲤达到捕鱼成就。如果希望苏镇锦鲤出现在你的收集栏中，请查看配置选项。 [list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]新家具:[/color]添加了34种小铭的家具，3种壁纸和2种地板，全部在一个新的家具目录里。 
[/list][size=4][center]
[b][color=#ffd966]推荐使用mod（可选）[/color][/b][/center][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#fff2cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5176]Non Destructive NPCs[/url]﻿[/color] ---- 无破坏性的npc，小铭喜欢散步，你可能不想他踢掉路上的一切物品。
[/list][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿[/color] ---- 查找一切，非常方便查看物品用途。
[/list][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url]﻿[/color] ---- 可以在地图上看到水域中的鱼，在苏镇非常美丽，强烈建议你关闭“Enable trash outside farm”也就是禁止垃圾出现在农场外的水域，这样在河道里就看不到垃圾了。
[/list]
[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b][center]mod适配[/center]
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]目前和以下NPC mod适配：[/size][list]
[*][color=#d5a6bd][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15100]﻿Seven Deadly Sins 七宗罪[/url]﻿﻿[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d5a6bd][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village 里奇赛德村[/url]﻿﻿[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d5a6bd] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]﻿[size=3]Downtown Zuzu 祖祖城[/size][/url]﻿[/color]
[*][color=#d5a6bd] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]﻿[size=3]Jorts and Jean 乔特和琼[/size][/url]﻿[/color]
[/list][size=3]其他的NPC mod适配性没有保证。
[/size][center][color=#616161][size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#ea9999][size=4][b]如果你遇到这些问题[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[list=1]
[*][color=#f4cccc]旧存档进入游玩第一天npc会留在出生点不动:[/color] 貌似几乎所有NPC mod都会有这个问题，睡一觉到第二天即可
[*][color=#f4cccc]事件中，院子里的动物不会移动，但会在原地不停变换方向:[/color] （应该）是正常的，事件结束就可以正常移动了
[*][color=#f4cccc]喂食小铭人偶时文本显示异常:[/color] 回想下是不是你进入主界面之后更改了语言，关闭游戏重新启动即可
[*][color=#f4cccc]如果晕倒在小铭家或院子中醒来之后UI全部消失:[/color] 退出到主界面重新进入存档即可，这个bug有的存档不会触发，目前不清楚原因
[*][color=#f4cccc]每天下午6点会卡一下:[/color] 是正常的，在替换夜晚图块
[*][color=#f4cccc]传送到新地图时，灯笼戒指熄灭了一下才亮:[/color] 灯笼戒指的发光效果是用Custom Companions做的，通过生成发光实体实现光源效果，所以在切换地图时要停一下才会传送到你身上，目前也没有找到更好的解决办法（）
[*][color=#f4cccc]吃下金龙锦鲤或茉莉蛋糕时给了双倍的buff等级:[/color] 这两种食物使用了Spacecore的再生效果，不知为何会导致提供的buff加成为物品描述的双倍（也就是吃下金龙锦鲤实际会增加4级钓鱼、4级幸运，这是本来设计的数值）

[/list][color=#e06666][size=4][b][center]已知问题[/center][/b][/size][/color]
如果其他mod添加了节日（which会强制把当天天气改为晴天），客房天气预报可能会误显示为改变之前的天气

[color=#c27ba0][size=4][b][center]其他[/center][/b][/size][/color][list=1]
[*]小铭人偶的功能代码是AI写的，因为我不会编程。但我测试了很多次来确保没有bug。如果有人需要的话之后我会把代码上传到github。
[*]这是我第一个大型扩展mod，技术力不足很抱歉，[b]如果遇到了bug请告知我，我会尽力修复。[/b]
[/list]

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
[center]
Do you want to meet this young boy Ming, who is gentle and sentimental, and came from a Chinese Jiangnan style town - Su Town?
[b]
Ming Mod adds a new NPC Ming and his cat.[/b] They live in the Backwoods, just the north of your farm.
Enter Backwoods from your farm, and on your left hand you'll see 2 fences standing beside the hill. Under the fences there is a hidden entrance to Ming's yard.
Or you can easily see it on my image.[/center]
[center]
[color=#ffd966][size=4][b]A Fair Warning
[/b][/size][/color][/center][list=1]
[*]Ming is a gentle, sentimental boy. He has an ex girlfriend, and will miss her a liitle when in low friendship. And he is also a little [b][color=#fff2cc]depressing[/color][/b] sometimes. If you're sensitive to these, please [b][color=#fff2cc]play at your own discretion[/color][/b].
[*]Currently I didn't make dating or marriage content. Ming will refuse your bouquet, and after 8 heart event, [b][color=#fff2cc]he will become non-dateable[/color][/b]. The reason is that I started this mod as a personal project, and I think it is now fulfiled for me. And obviously if I add dating or marriage content, there would be tons of dialogue and events, which would be a hugh task. For now I don't have that much energy. But[b] [color=#fff2cc]if many people really want to marry him, I might be able to update this.[/color][/b][color=#fff2cc] [/color]
[*]Therefore, please note that[color=#fff2cc][b] if you force Ming or Orangey into marriage (via other mods), I won't be able to fix the bugs. [/b][/color]For the intended experience, please don't do it. If you really want marriage content, you can leave your message here, and please respect and support my work. Thank you for your understanding.
[/list]
[b][color=#3d85c6][size=4][center]Features[/center][/size][/color][/b]
[color=#9fc5e8][size=4][b]New Character:[/b][/size][/color]
﻿Lots of portraits, schedules, animations.
[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]Plenty of dialogues:[/color] varies depending on seasons, hearts, special days, even years.
[*][color=#9fc5e8]Plenty of events:[/color]currently Ming has 12 events, including 0-8 heart events, 10 heart special event, birthday and new year events.
[/list] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿Note: [color=#ffe599]After some events, Ming would have special dialogue[/color], and even special items. So maybe you can try talk to him after events?[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]Plenty of mails:[/color] currently over 50 mails with 4 brand new letter paper, varies depending on seasons, festivals, events, and daily gift mails.
[/list]
[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=4]New Map:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]Ming's Yard:[/color] spawn foragable fruits, crops and fish, safe to pass out.
[*][color=#9fc5e8] ﻿Ming's Cabin:[/color] kitchen and sleep spot, safe to pass out.
[*][color=#9fc5e8]Su Town: [/color]Ming's hometown, currently for sightseeing and fishing, will update more functional content in the future.
[*] ﻿[color=#9fc5e8]Yeyu Inn: [/color]Su Town's inn and shop, safe to pass out.
[*] ﻿[color=#9fc5e8]Yeyu Inn Room: [/color]sleep spot, can bath (just like bath house), use kitchen, check calendar, check today's luck and tomorrow's weather.
[/list]
[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=4]New Items:[/size][/color][/b]
﻿Adds over 40 diffent items including food, boots, hat, fence, ring, etc, and adds 5 new buff to new food.
[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]New Recipes:[/color]
[/list] ﻿Including 3 food recipes, and 2 crafting recipes 
[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]New crop:[/color]
[/list] ﻿Su Town Jasmine, you can buy the seedings and its artisians in Yeyu Inn.
All the artisians have unique sprites and machine recipe.
[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]New Fish:[/color]
[/list] ﻿Adds 8 types of Koi in Su Town, including 2 really rare and difficult Boss fish (no 1 for each player limit).
﻿Varies depending on seasons and weather. All have a swimming animation when in fish tank, and have unique fish pond colors.
﻿Note: Default config is that these Koi are not on your Collection Tab, so that you don't need to get all of them to get fishing accomplishment.
﻿If you want them to be on your Collection Tab, please check the config. 
[list]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]New Furniture:[/color]
[/list] ﻿Currently adds 34 Ming's furniture, 3 wallpapers, and 2 floors. All in a New furniture catalogue. 
[size=4]
[b][color=#ffd966][center]Recommend Mods (Optional)[/center][/color][/b][/size][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5176]Non Destructive NPCs[/url]﻿[/color] ---- As Ming likes to wander around in Stardew Valley, and maybe you don't want him to kick everything out on his way
[/list][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿ [/color]---- So you can easily see an item's use 
[/list][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url]﻿[/color] ---- It will looks really beautiful in Su Town map. I highly recommend
you disable this configuration: "Enable trash outside farm", so you won't see trash in the river.[/list]
[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b][center]Compatiblity with Other NPC Mods[/center]
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]Now compatible with:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][color=#ead1dc] [color=#ead1dc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Seven Deadly Sins[/url]﻿﻿[/color][/color][/size]
[*][color=#ead1dc][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]﻿Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿[/size][/color]
[*][color=#ead1dc] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]﻿[size=3]Downtown Zuzu[/size][/url]﻿[/color]
[*][color=#ead1dc] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]﻿[size=3]Jorts and Jean[/size][/url]﻿[/color]
[/list][size=3]Other NPC mods are not guaranteed.
[/size][color=#616161][size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#ea9999][size=4][b][center]If you encounter this[/center][/b][/size][/color][list=1]
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you're playing with an already-existed save, and the 1st day my NPCs stuck in their bed:[/color] It's normal for all NPCs I guess, just sleep to the 2nd day and their schedule will work properly
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you're in the yard playing an event and the animals keep changing directions but never move:[/color] It's normal I guess, they will move normally when the event ends
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you're feeding the Ming Doll and the text shows wrong:[/color] Did you change language after you launched the game? Just close the game and start again, and it would be fine
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you pass out in Ming's yard or home, and find your UI missing after wake up:[/color] Exit to Title and start your save again. I don't know why this would happen, but this bug is very rare to encounter.
[*][color=#f4cccc]If time comes to 6 pm and you lag a few seconds:[/color] it's normal, the mod is changing map tiles to night version
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you're just warped to another map, and your Lantern ring stops to glow for a few seconds:[/color] I made the Lantern ring glow by adding Custom Companions on it, which would adds 2 glowing entities and they cannot warp with you precisely. Currently I can't find a better way to make the ring glow, sorry T.T
[*][color=#f4cccc]If you eat a Golden Loong Koi or a Jasmine Cake, and the buff says you got double buff level:[/color] These 2 food uses Spacecore's regenerate buff, and it leads to the real buff level is doubled as it says. So you actually get 4 Fish Level and 4 Luck Level eating a Golden Loong, and that is exactly what I meant.

[/list][color=#e06666][size=4][b][center]Known Issues[/center][/b][/size][/color]
﻿If other mods add festivals (which will force that day's weather to be sunny), the weather report in Yeyu Inn Room may still display the weather before the change.

[color=#c27ba0][size=4][b][center]Other Notes[/center][/b][/size][/color][list=1]
[*]English is not my first language. I’ve provided a basic translation to make the mod accessible. If you encounter any awkward phrasing or have suggestions for cultural nuances, please let me know kindly. I welcome any help to improve it!
[*]Ming Doll's codes are writed by AI, since I don't know much about coding. But I've tested many times to ensure it has no bugs. I will upload the code to github it anyone wants to do something about it.
[*]This is my first large-scale expansion mod. If you encounter any bugs or something, please report kindly. Sorry for my lack of skills!
[/list]
[quote]I may not be able to see posts on nexus in time. If you need, you can contact me via [color=#fff2cc][size=3][b] relsai@qq.com[/b][/size][/color][/quote]

Ming Mod Full Pack. If you're downloading this mod for the first time, just download this.

小铭mod完整包，如果你是第一次下载请选择这个。

If you're using older version, you can just download this and unzip it to overwrite the file. Make sure to replace it to the same folder ( [CP]Ming ).
-Fixed item's category.

如果你已经有了旧版，可以只下载这个包，选择替换文件。注意解压后要替换到一致的文件夹中（ [CP]Ming ）。
-修复了物品分类和空配方问题
